title: MeegXer user settings
description: Preferences of one user (settings.json in the MeegXer config folder). Personal choices only: nothing here changes what a pipeline computes, so none of it goes into pipelines, sessions or provenance. See docs/SETTINGS.md.

start_mode.description: The input mode a new pipeline starts in.

advanced.description: Start in advanced mode (every setting shown) instead of friendly mode.

reopen_last.description: Open the last pipeline when the daemon has none loaded.

daemon.description: Control endpoint of the daemon the GUI connects to (or starts).

confirm_quit_running.description: Ask what to do with a running pipeline when the window closes.

batch_jobs.description: Recordings an all-subjects BIDS run processes at once, each in its own process (0: one per CPU; 1: one after another). MEEGXER_BATCH_JOBS overrides it.

theme.description: dark, light, system (follow the operating system) or the path of a theme JSON file.

strip_width.description: Width of the strips in the chain: percent of the standard width (158 px), or "text" to follow the text size and the platform's font width.

sequential.description: Colour map for magnitudes (the head plot's heat map).

diverging.description: Colour map for signed changes (the head plot's change map).

peak.description: Colour map for frequencies (the head plot's peak-frequency map).

flip_on_light.description: Reverse the sequential and frequency maps on a light theme, so more is darker. Maps are the same in every theme by default.

span.description: Default time span of the signal view, in seconds.

time_axis.description: Live time axis: seconds before the newest data (fixed ticks, 0 at the right edge) or time since the stream started (sample index on the source's clock).

channels.description: Channels the signal view shows first: standard_19 (the 19 of the 10-20 system when a recording has more than 19 EEG channels, else every EEG channel) or all_eeg. Other types (EOG, ECG, ...) start hidden either way.

band.description: Default head-plot band [low, high] in Hz.

aperiodic.description: Show power above each channel's aperiodic (1/f) fit: a flattened spectrum and the band's periodic power in the head plot.

smoothing.description: Time constant (s) of the live spectrum smoothing; 0 is off.

review.description: How the review window shows a recording (docs/REVIEW.md), where the Review strip does not set it.

units.description: Scale the traces clinically (sensitivity in µV/mm and speed in mm/s, on the screen's real size) or by channel spacing in µV and seconds per page.

sensitivity.description: µV per mm of screen (units uv_per_mm).

speed.description: Mm of screen per second (units uv_per_mm).

offline_dir.description: Where offline runs keep their files (empty: the system temp folder). MEEGXER_OFFLINE_DIR overrides it.

cache_gb.description: Cap of the offline processor-output cache, in GB. MEEGXER_OFFLINE_CACHE_GB overrides it.

output_dir.description: Folder file dialogs start in when there is no last-used folder (empty: the working folder).

data_dir.description: Where your recordings live (e.g. a BIDS dataset): file dialogs for recording files (channel locations, montages, events) start there (empty: the last-used folder).

sample_dir.description: Where the sample datasets and their downloads go (empty: meegxer-samples in MNE's data folder, downloads in MNE's). MEEGXER_SAMPLE_DIR overrides it.
